meta.name: Kathmandu Connection
meta.description:
The story begins in 1993, a few months after a series of blasts in Mumbai that had shaken the whole country. A senior cop of Delhi police, Samarth Kaushik, gets involved in a mysterious revelation. A parallel investigation is taking place in Allahabad, over the killing of a customs officer a few months back. There are two common connections between all the cases, Bombay Blasts, and Kathmandu.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6 | S2 6/6

videos.title: The Connection
videos.overview: A kidnapping case falls on the desk of DCP Samarth Kaushik. Meanwhile, a news reporter is stalked and she informs Samarth about the same. The clues lead them to Hitesh, a CBI officer. Everything is connected.

videos.title: The Big Game
videos.overview: Samarth's investigation, which is off the records, leads him to Kathmandu. Shivani tells him the name of her stalker. Eventually, Samarth reaches another dead end.

videos.title: Rise And Fall
videos.overview: After his recent adventures, Samarth faces Suspension. Meanwhile, Shivani also faces issues at her workplace because of the continuous calls and gifts.

videos.title: Trump Card
videos.overview: Hitesh, Samarth, and Shravan get to know more about Sunny's business. They pit Sunny and Wajid against each other. Meanwhile, Samarth uses his trump card against Sunny.

videos.title: Ace King Queen
videos.overview: Sunny asks Shivani to come to Hong Kong with him. It can be a risky trip, but Shivani is adamant about going.

videos.title: All In
videos.overview: Sunny arrives in India. In the final face-off, he reveals their whole plan to Samarth. What will be Samarth's reaction when he learns the truth?

videos.title: Saazish
videos.overview: Shivani, now an investigative journalist in London, is assigned to cover the story of the hijack of Delhi-bound flight IC-814 from Kathmandu. Meanwhile, Sunny is serving his sentence in Central Jail and Samarth has quit his job and retreated to the hills of Uttarakhand.

videos.title: Khatra
videos.overview: Shivani's discovery of key evidence pushes her closer to learning about the big plan. Meanwhile, Wajid attacks Sunny in prison but the latter survives the attack.

videos.title: Dhamaka
videos.overview: Shivani is caught and held hostage by Ashraf Baig, who tortures her for information. Sunny, who learns about Shivani's disappearance, escapes from prison with the help of his cellmate.

videos.title: Sauda
videos.overview: Sunny, aided by Samarth's extensive research, frantically searches for Shivani. The two men, along with Shravan, launch an attack at the location where Shivani is being held.

videos.title: Dhokha
videos.overview: Samarth and Shravan approach Hitesh, a RAW agent, with the evidence that Shivani gathered. Later, Hitesh's instincts point him to foul play and he alerts his men.

videos.title: Ran-neeti
videos.overview: The President of Pakistan reaches Delhi for a meeting with his Indian counterpart. Meanwhile, Hitesh receives a tip that leads him to capture Wajid and Masood, who are being transported by Sunny.
